output:
To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in. That is the pitch fee, rates and water, and the gas safety check in March. Split four ways the same as always, that is £1,271.75 each.

It has gone up again, nearly £350 on last year. I am sorry about that but there is nothing I can do, the park sets it.

Please can you pay me by 31 January into the same account as before, as the park wants it all by then. If anyone would rather pay in two lots that is fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. That goes for everyone, just let me know.

The weeks for next year are as follows. There are no clashes this year.

Carol Easter week, and a week in September. Carol let me know which week in September you want.
Pete and Linda 29 May to 5 June (May half term).
Me and Bev 5 to 12 June. Pete, we will do the handover on the 5th.
Jan 7 to 14 August.

The park reopens on 1 March.

Pete mentioned the shower tray was cracked. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. It came to £140 for parts but I am not putting it on the bill, it is done.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned at us about it again.

One more thing so nobody is surprised later. The park says caravans over 15 years old need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 year old now, so we will need one done. I will find out more and let you know nearer the time.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
